author: ojiudezue
title: HA config backups (core.config_entries) never go in git; GitHub secret scanning blocked v5.103.95
summary: A pre-change backup of core.config_entries committed under docs/dashboard-prototypes/ura-v8-backups contained API keys; GitHub push protection refused the deploy. The commit was unpushed (not on GitHub or Gitea); it was scrubbed from the unpushed range with filter-branch, refs/original and reflog purged, backup moved to ~/.ura-backups (chmod 600), then v5.103.95 shipped.
why: core.config_entries holds every integration's credentials; the backups folder had only held dashboard/automation JSON before, so the habit of committing backups there was unsafe for this file type.
implications: Config-entry backups live in ~/.ura-backups only. Also: saving integration-entry (parent) options reloads all of URA; today's reloads recovered cleanly (counters restored ~30 s).
revisit_trigger: Any new backup step that copies .storage files into the repo.
